description: Manages and provides access to the organizational structure and hierarchy within the system.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchy
endpoints.description: Retrieves the complete organizational hierarchy structure.
example_uses: Show me the entire organizational structure.
Can I see the full org chart?
List all organizational units and their relationships.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to retrieve the full, current organizational hierarchy.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchyLegacy
endpoints.description: Retrieves a legacy version of the organizational hierarchy structure. This endpoint might be deprecated or provide data in an older format.
example_uses: Show me the legacy organizational structure.
Access the old org chart data.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this only if specifically instructed to access a legacy or historical version of the organizational hierarchy.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchyById
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific organizational unit by ID with complete details including hierarchy information.
example_uses: Show me details for org unit ID 138
Display org unit details for ID 789
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific organizational unit details by ID.

endpoints.name: GetMetadataInfo
endpoints.description: Describes the OrganizationHierarchy entity structure including all field configurations.
example_uses: What fields are available for organizational units?
Tell me about the structure of the organization hierarchy entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to understand the data structure and available fields for the OrganizationHierarchy entity.
